messages.content:
You are a typical viewer scrolling TikTok at night. You have NEVER seen this show and know nothing about its story or characters.
You will read several short clips. For each clip you get exactly what plays: spoken lines and what is on screen, with times in seconds from the first frame of THAT clip (0.0 = the moment it appears in your feed). [CUT] marks a jump to a later moment.
Judge each clip ON ITS OWN, as if it were the only one you ever saw. Never use information from one clip to understand another.
Be a harsh, honest judge. Most clips are mediocre. Reserve 5 for truly scroll-stopping work.
Scores (1-5):
- hook: would 0-3 s make you stop scrolling? Judge only what happens in 0.0-3.0 s.
- standalone: could you follow who is who and what is at stake without knowing the show?
- cliffhanger: does it cut at an unresolved moment that makes you NEED the next part? 1 if it resolves or ends flat.
- tap_to_watch: overall, would you tap through to watch the show?
Return JSON only.

=== CLIP A (41.5 s) ===
[0.0-2.2] THE BEARDED STRANGER (Low, Thunderous, Imposing): "Take your hands off her."
[0.6-2.9] SCREEN: Medium tracking shot front-on as The Bearded Stranger marches down the flower-strewn aisle with resolute purpose.
[2.9-5.2] SCREEN: Medium shot on the Noble Matriarch stepping forward on the altar steps, furiously pointing a finger at him.
[3.1-6.9] NOBLE MATRIARCH (Indignant, Screeching): "And who are you to give orders in my family's chapel?!"
[5.2-7.1] SCREEN: High wide shot of the magnificent vaulted hall as The Bearded Stranger walks steadily forward, dwarfing the aisle.
[7.1-9.1] SCREEN: Medium shot on the lead royal guard squaring his shoulders, barring the stranger's advance while Juliana stands behind him.
[7.3-9.0] ROYAL GUARD (Aggressive, Threatening): "Stand aside, stranger!"
[9.1-11.1] SCREEN: Medium close-up profile on The Bearded Stranger, eyes burning with quiet, lethal resolve.
[9.4-11.0] THE BEARDED STRANGER (Quiet, Deadly): "I said..."
[11.1-14.1] SCREEN: Close-up on The Bearded Stranger's intense, scarred face.
[11.9-14.0] THE BEARDED STRANGER (Dangerous, Uncompromising): "...let her go."
[14.1-15.6] SCREEN: Medium action shot as the guard charges toward The Bearded Stranger.
[14.1-15.6] ACTION: The Bearded Stranger effortlessly blocks the guard's strike and drives a devastating strike into him, dropping the armed guard instantly to the floor.
[14.6-15.5] SOUND_FX: A heavy, bone-rattling punch followed by the clatter and thud of the guard collapsing onto the stone floor.
[CUT]
[15.6-17.9] THE BEARDED STRANGER (Honorable, Earnest): "You came here to become a wife."
[16.8-19.0] SCREEN: Medium shot on The Bearded Stranger extending the ring toward Juliana.
[18.3-20.0] THE BEARDED STRANGER (Quiet, Resolute): "They took that from you."
[19.0-20.9] SCREEN: Over-the-shoulder medium shot past The Bearded Stranger onto Gerald standing petrified and humiliated in the aisle.
[20.9-23.2] SCREEN: Medium close-up on The Bearded Stranger presenting the ring directly to Juliana.
[21.1-23.1] THE BEARDED STRANGER (Earnest, Sincere): "I am offering it back."
[23.2-26.0] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana glancing down at the ring, breathless and overwhelmed.
[23.5-25.7] LADY JULIANA (Soft, Hesitant): "You don't even know me."
[26.0-28.5] SCREEN: Close-up on The Bearded Stranger's warm, piercing gaze.
[26.2-27.8] THE BEARDED STRANGER (Quiet, Steady): "I know enough."
[28.5-31.3] SCREEN: Full wide profile shot as The Bearded Stranger slowly and respectfully drops onto one knee before Lady Juliana.
[29.0-31.3] ACTION: The Bearded Stranger sinks to one knee on the cathedral aisle, offering the silver ring up to Juliana.
[30.6-32.0] SOUND_FX: A collective, stunned gasp rippling across the entire congregation.
[31.3-33.1] SCREEN: Medium shot of the Noble Matriarch, Gerald, and the Lady in Gold Gown frozen in sheer, jaw-dropped bewilderment.
[33.1-36.3] SCREEN: Low-angle medium close-up of The Bearded Stranger on his knee, holding the silver ring high with steady dignity.
[33.3-36.1] THE BEARDED STRANGER (Solemn, Devoted): "Lady Juliana... accept my hand."
[36.3-41.5] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana looking down at him, fresh tears trailing down her flushed cheeks as a soft, trembling smile of hope touches her lips into a slow fade.

[20.0-22.9] NOBLE MATRIARCH (Stern, Final): "Your father has chosen his family..."

[23.0-24.9] NOBLE MATRIARCH (Coldly Severing): "...and it isn't you."

[25.0-26.7] NOBLE MATRIARCH (Shouting, Imperious): "Guards! Remove her!"

[27.2-29.2] ACTION: The guards forcefully grab Juliana by both shoulders and drag her backwards.
[27.3-29.0] LADY JULIANA (Screaming, Resisting): "Let me go!"
[28.7-29.9] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana's hand frantically grabbing the wooden rim of a pew, knuckles white with strain.
[29.1-30.2] LADY JULIANA (Desperate, Begging): "Please! Someone!"
[29.7-31.2] ACTION: The guards tear her grip away from the pew.
[29.7-31.2] SOUND_FX: Muffled scuffle, rustle of heavy silk and frantic gasps echoing off cathedral stone.
[31.2-32.7] SCREEN: High wide shot down the vaulted cathedral aisle showing the entire congregation watching in stunned silence as the guards drag Juliana.
[32.7-34.8] SCREEN: Wide eye-level shot looking down the petal-strewn marble aisle. A tall, rugged man in a worn dark trench coat—The Bearded Stranger—emerges into the center of the nave.
[32.7-34.8] ACTION: The Bearded Stranger steps deliberately into the aisle, his heavy boots echoing.
[34.8-37.2] SCREEN: Close-up on the Noble Matriarch freezing in utter shock and outrage.
